beats.say: You might think rookie pop groups stay local, but BABYMONSTER just went global.
NME reports the group added six new North American stops to their 2025 Hello Monsters world tour.
Their first mini-album BABYMONS7ER arrived in April last year, featuring the debut single Batter Up and Sheesh.
Then in October 2024, they released their very first studio album, Drip.
The record delivered massive singles like Forever, Clik Clak, and the title track Drip.
The title track was even co-written by Big Bang member G-Dragon.
Which BABYMONSTER song is currently on repeat for you?

facts: BABYMONSTER announced six new North American stops as part of their ongoing 2025 Hello Monsters world tour.
The K-pop girl group also released their first mini-album called BABYMONS7ER in April last year.
The project included their debut single, Batter Up, as well as the hit single Sheesh.
In October 2024, BABYMONSTER released their first studio album, titled Drip.
The record features the singles Forever, Clik Clak and Drip, the latter of which was co-written by Big Bang member G-Dragon.
